en: Dependent on a wholesome state coexistent with consciousness, there arises a state not coexistent with consciousness that is not wholesome by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*)... [In the case of root: nine... [and so on] ...in non-disappearance: nine.

Dependent on an unwholesome state coexistent with consciousness, there arises a state not coexistent with consciousness that is not unwholesome by way of root-condition... [In the case of root: nine... [and so on] ...in non-disappearance: nine. (For the indeterminate roots, there are only three conditions.)
